name: Ambush in the Entry Hall
notes: Brandon's example cutscene (FR-5): nine soldiers rush in the south door and surround the party, spears pointed at the center, then a mage enters and the center light blooms. Validate with `bun run cutscene --file examples/ambush.json --validate-only` — no connection needed. To play it, the Soldier and Mage actors must exist in the world (or be created first), and the spear tile must be uploaded to worlds/testbed/spear.png (`uploadTilePack` covers the whole pack). The scene is the Lich's Lair Entry Hall (1600x1600, door gap at the south wall, center at 800,800). The light is addressed by proximity to the room center — it picks the nearest AmbientLight.

steps.content: The mage raises a hand — light blooms at the center of the room, and nine spear-points catch the glow.
